mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE spike does not correlate with subsequent market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent market rallies.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening of monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in loosening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 5% & UNRATE falls > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the joint increase in HOUST and decrease in UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent market rallies.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or PAYEMS increase does not correlate with subsequent market rallies.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals weakening supply-side fundamentals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, especially during a late-cycle regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or INDPRO decrease does not correlate with subsequent market downturns during late-cycle regimes.
